title: Maximum Strength Of A Group
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, choose a nonempty subset and compute the product of its values. Return the maximum product possible.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [3, -1, -5, 2, 5, -9]
Output: 1350
```

```text
Input: nums = [-4, -5, -4]
Output: 20
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 13`
- `-9 <= nums[i] <= 9`
